reviews.title: App is not working with new apple update
reviews.text: I cannot use the app with new iphone update

reviews.title: Need update
reviews.text:
Every time I try to upload a photo or video.
The app closes I remove the app and redownload it to see if that fixes and now I can not recover my photos and videos when I try.
It’s not sending and receiving code to my email

reviews.title: trash app
reviews.text: if you're ok with never setting your photos again then this is the app for you. god forbid you forget your password too because you will never receive the password recovery email they claim to send you and only respond to emails with automated bots who only repeat the same phrase every time. waste of money
